subject: Shiny Code Placement in R Markdown

messages.author: 7b36a5521b8eb4d4
messages.subject: Shiny Code Placement in R Markdown
parts: Is it possible to achieve a nice result with a Shiny application in an R Markdown file when showing the code used ? The quintessential example uses echo = FALSE to hide the code, because otherwise the Shiny widgets appear immediately after their declaration. I suppose I'd like it to work well with results = "hold", if possible. Also, is there an easy way to center-align the shiny plot created ?
